prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-04-16, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-04-16):
| Return 3m            | +41.3% |
| Return 1m            | +8.2% |
| Return 1w            | +4.9% |
| Range position (63d) | 87% |
| 21d realized vol     | 44% |
| Last close           | 39.92 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has shown strong momentum with a +41.3% 3-month return and +8.2% in the last month, indicating durable upside. Despite trading near the 63-day range high (87% position), the continuation of positive momentum and solid recent performance support further near-term gains. Expectation of continued strength over ~20 trading days warrants a bullish stance.

DECISION: BUY
